info.name: EnatAI - Maternal Health Clinical Backend API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman API Collection for EnatAI Maternal Health Platform.

Includes Authentication, Maternal Onboarding, Gestational Calculator, WHO 8-Contact ANC Schedule, Voice & Text Check-in, Ethiopian Nutrition & Food Group Classification, Supplements, Appointments, Clinician Summaries & QR Sharing, Notifications, and Text-to-Speech (TTS).

request.description: Returns operational status of the FastAPI backend.
Returns 202 verification_required. Confirm email before login.
Authenticates user and returns JWT bearer access token.
Sends password reset email link.
Updates password with recovery token.
Instant public preview calculator without needing authentication. Computes gestational age in weeks & days, trimester, and EDD.
